newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bank IPB dividend falls by half.
newsitem.headline: Czech bank IPB dividend falls by half.

text.p: Shareholders of Czech bank IPB a.s. on Thursday approved the payment of an eight crown per share gross dividend on 1996 profits, the CTK news agency reported.
IPB paid out a 16 crown per share gross dividend for 1995.

IPB posted a 1996 net profit, according to international accounting standards, of 882 million crowns, down from 1.01 billion crowns in 1995 mainly on the creation of reserves and provisions, as ordered by its auditor, Ernst & Young.
The bank's reserves at end 1996 totalled 10.134 billion crowns, up from 8.882 at year-end 1995.
The government is currently negotiating with Japanese bank Nomura International to sell its 36 percent stake in IPB.
IPB Director Jiri Tesar told shareholders at the AGM that he expects the sale to be completed by the end of the summer.
